text.tspan: Open defecation in rural areas vs. urban areas 2024
Open defecation refers to defecating in the open, such as in fields, forests, bushes, open bodies of water, on
beaches, in other open spaces, or disposed of with solid waste.

tspan.tspan: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene (2025)
Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2023 is shown instead.
